meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: Claude 可以从目录、网址、粘贴的笔记或当前对话中提取可重复步骤，生成或更新一个 SKILL.md 技能文件。
howto.when: 当你说出“/learn”、“learn this”、“turn this into a skill”、“capture this workflow”等短语时触发。

say.note: 根据项目目录创建技能。
从当前对话流程创建技能。

howto.what_en: Claude can extract repeatable steps from a directory, URL, pasted notes, or current conversation to generate or update a SKILL.md file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "/learn", "learn this", "turn this into a skill", "capture this workflow", etc.

say_en.note: Creates a skill from a project directory.
Creates a skill from the current conversation workflow.
